title: What’s actually in your glass?
sub: Six drinks. One reel. Save it.

cards.name: Whisky
cards.from: Grain: barley, corn, rye or wheat
cards.fact: Aged in wooden casks. Most of its colour comes from the wood.
cards.tip: Paani ki do boond. Science hai.

cards.name: Rum
cards.from: Sugarcane: molasses or fresh cane juice
cards.fact: Molasses is what’s left after making sugar. Nothing goes to waste.

cards.name: Vodka
cards.from: Almost anything that ferments: grain, potatoes, even grapes
cards.fact: Usually not aged, and filtered to taste clean and neutral.
cards.tip: Plain hai, isliye sab mein mil jaata hai.

cards.name: Gin
cards.from: A neutral spirit, flavoured with botanicals
cards.fact: Juniper berries must lead the flavour. In the EU, that’s the law.

cards.name: Tequila
cards.fact: Real tequila can only be made in Mexico.

cards.name: Brandy
cards.fact: Cognac is brandy from one region of France: Cognac.

outro.cta: Send this to the friend who always orders “kuch bhi”.
outro.pill: DRINK SLOW · NEVER DRINK AND DRIVE

caption:
What is whisky actually made from? 🥃 And rum, vodka, gin, tequila and brandy? Large Sahab explains all six in 30 seconds.

Whisky: grain, aged in wood. Rum: sugarcane. Vodka: almost anything that ferments. Gin: botanicals, led by juniper. Tequila: blue agave, only in Mexico. Brandy: distilled wine.

Save this for your next bar order, and send it to the friend who always orders “kuch bhi”. Which one is your drink? Tell us below.

Drink slow. Never drink and drive. 18+
